source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
observations: EXE/OK opens an angle editor with the stored expression and cursor at its beginning. Empty EXE/OK ignored; Back cancels only the edit.
DEL clears the entire selected angle. When both angles are empty Execute is disabled; EXE and SETTINGS there are ignored.
SETTINGS ignored in angle edit, type selection, plot and at Execute. SETTINGS allowed on other form rows; changing angle unit preserves expression 30.
Circle stores the expression before evaluating it. 1+ is accepted into the form; Execute then raises Syntax ERROR. 1/0 similarly raises Math ERROR only on Execute.
Run errors return to the form with Type selected; expressions are preserved. Unit angle 10000 gives Range ERROR.
Form fields preserve pi/6 as expression, also on reopen; the plot computes with the current angle unit.
